# Managed-file guards — index.md and log.md are refused by delete and index remove

exec akb init guard-kb
cd guard-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/note.yaml
exec git add .agent-kb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note template'

# === MANAGED FILES REFUSED VIA DOT-SEGMENT PATHS ===

! exec akb delete ./index.md
stderr 'cannot delete index.md'

! exec akb delete kb/./log.md
stderr 'cannot delete log.md'

! exec akb index remove index.md
stderr 'cannot remove index.md from index'

! exec akb index remove kb/./log.md
stderr 'cannot remove log.md from index'

# === MANAGED FILES SURVIVE THE REFUSALS ===

exists kb/index.md

# === NORMAL DELETE STILL WORKS ===

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write smoke-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/smoke-note.md'

exec akb delete notes/smoke-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/smoke-note.md'
! exists kb/notes/smoke-note.md

# === NORMAL INDEX REMOVE STILL WORKS ===

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write smoke-two.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/smoke-two.md'

exec akb index add kb/notes/smoke-two.md 'smoke summary'
stdout 'Added kb/notes/smoke-two.md to index'

exec akb index show
stdout 'smoke-two.md'

exec akb index remove kb/notes/smoke-two.md
stdout 'Removed kb/notes/smoke-two.md from index'

exec akb index show
! stdout 'smoke-two.md'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Guard Smoke Note
summary: A note for managed-file guard tests
---
Body content.
